value.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_measures_registry_registered_pac_snapshot_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if old.pac_key like 'measures_registry_home_c3webpac_v0_%' and old.is_effective is true and old.standing='active' then if new.pac_key is distinct from old.pac_key or new.pac_type is distinct from old.pac_type or new.version is distinct from old.version or new.custody_uri is distinct from old.custody_uri or new.content_sha256 is distinct from old.content_sha256 or new.custody_provider is distinct from old.custody_provider or new.custodian_subject_type is distinct from old.custodian_subject_type or new.custodian_subject_key is distinct from old.custodian_subject_key then raise exception 'DNR: registered MR PAC snapshot is immutable while active/effective; form/supersede PAC instead'; end if; end if; return new; end $function$

value.name: trg_c3_hardened_pac_immutable_guard_v1
value.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_c3_hardened_pac_immutable_guard_v1 BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.c3_pac FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c3_hardened_pac_immutable_guard_v1()
value.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c3_hardened_pac_immutable_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_context text:=current_setting('c3.pac_registrar_context',true);
begin
  if old.registration_protocol<>'registrar_v1' then
    return new;
  end if;

  if nullif(v_context,'') is null then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 PAC is immutable; supersede through Registrar';
  end if;

  if (
    new.pac_key is distinct from old.pac_key
    or new.envpac_key is distinct from old.envpac_key
    or new.pac_type is distinct from old.pac_type
    or new.version is distinct from old.version
    or new.standing is distinct from old.standing
    or new.custody_uri is distinct from old.custody_uri
    or new.content_sha256 is distinct from old.content_sha256
    or new.source_authority is distinct from old.source_authority
    or new.metadata is distinct from old.metadata
    or new.schema_key is distinct from old.schema_key
    or new.owner_subject_type is distinct from old.owner_subject_type
    or new.owner_subject_key is distinct from old.owner_subject_key
    or new.owner_environment_key is distinct from old.owner_environment_key
    or new.registration_sha256 is distinct from old.registration_sha256
    or new.boundary_evaluation_key is distinct from old.boundary_evaluation_key
    or new.registered_at is distinct from old.registered_at
    or new.registrar_role_call_key is distinct from old.registrar_role_call_key
  ) then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 PAC registered content cannot be mutated in place';
  end if;

  return new;
end $function$

value.name: trg_c3_pac_free_completeness_guard_v1
value.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER trg_c3_pac_free_completeness_guard_v1 AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.c3_pac DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION c3_pac_free_completeness_guard_v1()
value.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.c3_pac_free_completeness_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_missing_scope integer;
  v_missing_snapshot integer;
begin
  if new.registration_protocol<>'registrar_v1'
     or new.is_effective is not true
     or new.superseded_at is not null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_missing_scope
  from public.c3_pac_encounter_scope s
  where s.pac_key=new.pac_key
    and s.standing='active'
    and (
      s.free_call_key is null
      or s.selector_type is null
      or not exists(
        select 1 from public.c3_free_call c
        where c.free_call_key=s.free_call_key and c.standing='active'
      )
    );

  if v_missing_scope>0 then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 FREE call binding required';
  end if;

  select count(*) into v_missing_snapshot
  from public.c3_pac_encounter_scope s
  join public.c3_free_call c on c.free_call_key=s.free_call_key and c.standing='active'
  where s.pac_key=new.pac_key
    and s.standing='active'
    and c.requires_projection=true
    and not exists(
      select 1 from public.c3_free_pac_snapshot fs
      where fs.pac_key=s.pac_key
        and fs.free_call_key=s.free_call_key
        and fs.encounter_key=s.encounter_key
        and fs.standing='active'
        and fs.registration_sha256=new.registration_sha256
    );

  if v_missing_snapshot>0 then
    raise exception 'registrar_v1 FREE projection snapshot required';
  end if;

  return null;
end
$function$

value.function_definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_measures_registry_registered_pac_member_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ declare v_pac_key text:=coalesce(new.pac_key,old.pac_key); v_effective boolean; v_standing text; begin if v_pac_key not like 'measures_registry_home_c3webpac_v0_%' then return coalesce(new,old); end if; select is_effective,standing into v_effective,v_standing from public.c3_pac where pac_key=v_pac_key; if coalesce(v_effective,false) and v_standing='active' then if tg_op='DELETE' then raise exception 'DNR: required registered MR PAC member cannot be removed while PAC is active/effective'; end if; if old.required is true and old.standing='registered' and (new.pac_key is distinct from old.pac_key or new.member_kind is distinct from old.member_kind or new.member_role is distinct from old.member_role or new.source_object_key is distinct from old.source_object_key or new.custody_provider is distinct from old.custody_provider or new.custody_identifier is distinct from old.custody_identifier or new.custody_location is distinct from old.custody_location or new.runtime_binding_key is distinct from old.runtime_binding_key or new.required is distinct from old.required or new.release_scope is distinct from old.release_scope or new.standing is distinct from old.standing) then raise exception 'DNR: registered MR PAC member declaration is immutable while PAC is active/effective; form/supersede PAC instead'; end if; end if; return coalesce(new,old); end $function$
